svg.title: What each line of an inventory entry is for
svg.desc: A single home-inventory entry for a bicycle, with each of its five lines paired to the job that line does in an insurance claim. The description line is a replacement instruction rather than a category. The serial number is the only field that cannot be reconstructed after the item is gone. The purchase line is deliberately approximate. The proof line is a pointer to where evidence lives rather than the evidence itself. The photograph places the item inside your home.
svg.text: Bicycle — Trek FX 3 Disc, 2022, matt black
Receipt photographed below; card stmt Jul 2022
Photo: in the hall, by the radiator
A replacement instruction, not a category
The one field you cannot reconstruct later
Approximate and honest beats confident and wrong
A pointer to the proof, not the proof itself
Places the item inside your home
Written on the day it arrives, this takes a minute. Written after a break-in, the second line cannot be written at all.
